name: Pipeliners - Scottsdale Keyword Research 2026-10-10
body:
> Research · Pipeliners · 2026-10-10

# Summary
Keyword research and page copy draft for /scottsdale/ (post 13760), Oct 10, 2026. Covers two sources: the folder `scottsdale-keyword-research-2026-10-10` (report, copy draft, Word version, GSC export) and the longer read-only report `reports\scottsdale-keyword-research-2026-10-10.md`, which also lists the rules the copy must follow (passed to ChatGPT).

# Key findings
- Page performance (Jul 11 to Oct 8): 480 to 521 impressions, 2 clicks, average position about 37 to 38. No Scottsdale terms at positions 4 to 20.
- Live setup since Oct 2: title "Sewer Line Replacement in Scottsdale, AZ | Pipeliners", H1 "Trenchless Sewer Line Replacement in Scottsdale, AZ", meta about pool decks and pavers. Early check of the Oct 2 change was flat; the planned read is Oct 26.
- Grouped demand: sewer line replacement or repair about 135 impressions (largest), trenchless sewer repair about 70, water line about 20, pipe lining or repair about 20.
- Search Atlas (project 5108451): Scottsdale variants show 0 volume except "sewer line repair scottsdale" (30). Parents: sewer line replacement 4,400 (KD 29), trenchless sewer repair 4,400 (KD 15).
- Cannibalization: no other website page competes. The GBP link ranks 1 to 6 for "trenchless sewer repair scottsdale" but 41 for "sewer line replacement scottsdale", so the page and GBP cover different terms. CIPP belongs to /what-is-cipp/ (10,283 impressions); "no dig" has 0 Scottsdale impressions.
- Repipe queries are not targets (Pipeliners does not do full repipes).

# Decisions and status
- Keep the primary "sewer line replacement in Scottsdale, AZ"; secondary terms: trenchless sewer repair or replacement, sewer line repair, water line replacement (ePIPE section).
- Worth adding: a "Can your sewer pipe be lined?" section, a short process section, and a link to Scottsdale's official permit page (must return 200 twice).
- Copy rules: "Pipeliners" only; no "pipe lining" or "pipelining" as a noun, no "pipeline" or "pigging"; no em dashes; no 24/7, same-day, prices, "best", "only ePIPE installer" or guarantees; allowed claims include the 20-year drain-lining warranty, 10-year ePIPE warranty, 50+ and 75+ year life, "up to 30% savings" and permits pulled; no full repipes, pipe bursting, gas lines, manhole lining or Kitec; external links only to .gov, .edu or standards bodies.
- The copy draft keeps title, meta and H1 unchanged; an improved content refresh (in the SEO baseline folder) is on hold until the Oct 26 read.

# Files in this folder (rollups only)
- `Scottsdale-Keyword-Research-2026-10-10.md`, `Scottsdale-Page-Copy-Draft-2026-10-10.md`, `Scottsdale_10 Oct 26_Pipeliners.docx` (Word copy), `gsc-scottsdale-queries-2026-07-11_to_2026-10-08.csv`.
